isakos-meniscal.l: Rim width at the outermost zone reached

isgls-bile-leak.l: Drain bilirubin >= 3x serum on/after POD 3, OR need for radiologic/operative intervention (the bile-leak gate)
Change in management without relaparotomy (percutaneous drainage, ERCP/stent), or a grade A leak persisting > 1 week (Grade B)

isgls-phlf.l: Increased INR (or FFP need) AND hyperbilirubinemia on/after POD 5 (rising if abnormal preop) — the PHLF gate
Requires invasive treatment: hemodialysis/RRT, mechanical ventilation, vasopressors, rescue hepatectomy or salvage transplant (Grade C)
Deviation managed without invasive treatment: FFP, albumin, diuretics, non-invasive ventilation, or ICU admission alone (Grade B)

isgps-dge.l: Nasogastric tube required (days): 4-7 = A, 8-14 = B, >14 = C
NGT reinsertion postoperative day (0 = none): after POD 3 = A, after POD 7 = B, after POD 14 = C
Unable to tolerate solid oral intake by postoperative day (0 = tolerating): POD 7 = A, POD 14 = B, POD 21 = C

isgps-popf.l: Drain amylase > 3x upper limit of normal serum amylase, on/after POD 3 (the POPF gate)
Reoperation, single/multiple organ failure, or death attributable to POPF (Grade C)
Clinically relevant change in management: drains > 3 wk or repositioned, percutaneous/endoscopic drainage, octreotide/antibiotics, angio for bleeding, or infection without organ failure (Grade B)

ishlt-rejection.l: The revised ISHLT grade. Enter the R form only - a 1990-scheme grade or a bare number is refused with its mapping, because the two schemes reuse the same numbers [0R = Grade 0R (no rejection): No evidence of rejection: unremarkable endomyocardium with no lymphocytic infiltration. (from 1990 grade 0) 1R = Grade 1R (mild, low grade): Interstitial and/or perivascular infiltrate with up to one focus of myocyte damage. Myocardial architecture is otherwise intact. (from 1990 grades 1A, 1B, 2) 2R = Grade 2R (moderate, intermediate grade): Two or more foci of infiltrate with associated myocyte damage, with uninvolved myocardium present between the foci. (from 1990 grade 3A) 3R = Grade 3R (severe, high grade): Diffuse infiltrate with multifocal myocyte damage, with or without edema, hemorrhage, or vasculitis. A diffuse process in which distinct foci cannot be made out. (from 1990 grades 3B, 4)]

ishoo-angioedema.l: The airway is threatened right now (an emergency at any stage; it overrides the staging)

isis-shoulder.l: Glenoid loss of contour on AP radiograph

isl-lymphedema.l: The stage, describing what the tissue has become [0 = Stage 0 (latent or subclinical): Swelling is not yet evident despite impaired lymph transport, with subtle alterations in tissue fluid and composition and changes in subjective symptoms. Not applicable. Not applicable: there is no overt edema to pit. I = Stage I: An early accumulation of fluid relatively high in protein content. The swelling SUBSIDES with limb elevation. Pitting MAY occur. II = Stage II: More changes in solid structures. Limb elevation alone RARELY reduces the tissue swelling. Pitting IS manifest. late II = Late stage II: Excess subcutaneous fat and fibrosis develop. Elevation does not reduce the swelling. The limb MAY NOT pit. That is fibrosis replacing fluid, not improvement. III = Stage III: Lymphostatic elephantiasis, with trophic skin changes such as acanthosis, alterations in skin character and thickness, further deposition of fat and fibrosis, and warty overgrowths. Elevation does not reduce the swelling. Pitting CAN BE ABSENT. Again, that is fibrosis, not improvement.]

Severity by excess volume difference between limbs - a SEPARATE axis from the stage [none = Not graded, Excess volume at or below 5 percent. Subclinical lymphedema is measurable from about 3 to 5 percent, which sits below the minimal grade, so a limb can be measurably abnormal and still ungraded. minimal = Minimal, Excess volume above 5 percent and below 20 percent. moderate = Moderate, Excess volume of 20 to 40 percent. severe = Severe, Excess volume above 40 percent.]
Is the swelling bilateral? Required, because the severity grade is an inter-limb comparison and bilateral swelling understates the disease.

isth-dic.l: Underlying disorder associated with DIC is present (required gate)
